text: Agreed to pace rolling endurance rides steadily on climbs without surging, guided by conversational breathing and comfortable cadence.
The final riser felt unusually hard, but this was attributed to a headwind and a long day on the feet rather than a negative fitness trend.
For exposed windy stretches, agreed to ride lower on the bars and shift snacks earlier, while monitoring hand and shoulder comfort as volume increases.
Mild leg heaviness on day two of back-to-back rides cleared after 20 minutes of easy spinning; the plan remains unchanged, with the second ride to be shortened if heaviness lasts beyond 30 minutes.
For rides over two hours, agreed on one bottle per hour, food every 30 minutes, and a larger breakfast before sustained climbing; the routine will first be practiced on easy rides.

The park-side route with fewer junctions made it easier to keep recovery riding genuinely easy, with relaxed breathing throughout; recovery spins will use this route going forward and remain protected when schedules get busy.
